title: Large Language Models for Market Research: A Data-Augmentation Approach
authors: Mengxin Wang; Dennis Zhang; Heng Zhang
eligible_reason: Methodological paper on augmenting conjoint data with LLM-generated responses (AAE vs PPI); choice-model estimation on survey data. No DiD.
design_notes: Python scripts debias.py/naive.py/ppi.py estimate conjoint logit parameters on real and GPT-generated choice data (vaccine and car studies); notebooks build Sections 5-6 results.
data_files_note: Real and LLM-generated conjoint datasets shipped (CC BY 4.0).
data_provenance_note: Real conjoint responses plus LLM-generated responses as used in the paper.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ empty for this suffix); screened from README, code, data and the OpenAlex abstract. Out of scope.
